data.long_meaning: Ardy is derived from the Greek word ‘Ardys’, which means ‘man’ or ‘brave’. In ancient Greek culture, Ardys was a popular name for warriors and leaders. In the Christian tradition, this name is associated with the virtue of courage. The name Ardy carries the meaning “Man, Brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ardy usually hope their child will grow to embody man, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
